en: SAPHIRA: You're part of the family too, you know.
Not in the same way as my sisters.
There's a pecking order you have to deal with,
But you're in it.
SAPHIRA: I'm not here to party, just to chaperone.
Seeing everyone safe...
That's enough for me.
HEATHER: Oh, hey, \PN.
Been a while, huh?
Shelly's been all worried ever since you went AWOL.
Julia told her you'd been eaten by a Darkrai or something.
But clearly you weren't.
I mean, if you DID see a Darkrai, that'd be pretty cool!
...But I'm glad it didn't eat you.
HEATHER: \PN!
I've gotta ask you something!
So I heard-- did you really travel through time?
I hadn't heard all the details, but I'd pestered Simon to tell me the gist of it after you'd come back--
I mean, Celebi's the Time Travel Pokémon, right?
You've got to have!
Did you see anything?
Meet anyone?
HEATHER: You really met my future self?! Was I cool?
And my mom?! Like, seriously?
I mean, I know I inherited her old Elite Four room, but I didn't think that you would've actually been able to see her!
HEATHER: ...She really jumped down that far? When you first entered the room?
That sounds INCREDIBLE!
I mean, what an entrance!
I've GOT to try that sometime!
HEATHER: Man.
That picnic was the best.
Pretty sure I didn't actually eat anything,
But how many people can say they've actually raced an Yveltal?
It was incredible!
Salamence had a riot, too, he loves going super fast.
Hey... You caught that Yveltal, right?
You think it might want a rematch sometime?
Maybe now that it's not all caught in that Anomaly aura, it'd have fun racing.
I know I sure would!
HEATHER: Good to see you without that green jerk this time!
Not Fern, I mean that girl who fought me with you.
No offense, \PN, but you’ve got some weird taste in company.
What a bitch!
I know, I know, you have to deal with all kinds of people when you’re a League employee, blah blah, whatever. That doesn’t make it fun.
She was pretty strong, though, I’ll give her that. The battle was actually pretty fun.
Just don’t tell her that, if you see her again.
Some things aren’t worth it no matter how cool the battle is.
HEATHER: Y'know, I heard about what happened at the Battle Wheel.
With Meloetta and everything.
I know it sounds kinda dumb, but I wish I'd been there.
It sounded like a fun time.
And the Battle Wheel sounds pretty cool, too.
I think they're closing it up for a while, which sucks,
But as soon as they open it up again, I'm gonna give it a try.
Meloetta won't be there, but it should still be fun.
HEATHER: Hey, \PN.
I know all this Anomaly stuff is kind of a mess...
But it's kind of awesome, too!
Shelly and I are gonna get back out there soon.
HEATHER: Hope you're ready to lose next time you drop by the League!
HEATHER: Hey.
Thanks for helping.
HEATHER: I hope everyone's doing okay over in Beryl.
I haven't been by in a while.
Maybe I should stop over later.
LAURA: Hi, \PN! Are you enjoying the music?
It's a bit of an acquired taste, but it's really growing on me.
BENNETT: Hello, \PN. It's good to see that Lin's final curse upon you was not permanent.
BENNETT: Oh, don't worry. Julia told me what happened.
I suspect that as a Bug-type expert, she thought I might be able to help.
It was just a shame that you ran off so quickly.
I told her your new instincts must have been kicking in.
LAURA: We've both been concerned, ever since.
BENNETT: Of course, you may have preferred not to see me, regardless.
Once again, I am deeply sorry for my prior actions.
But if I might trouble you--
What was it like, being a Wimpod?
Do you remember it at all?
BENNETT: You don't remember, of course.
I'm very sorry, once again.
And it truly is good to see you restored to your proper form.
LAURA: It really is good to see you.
Feel free to stop by, any time you feel like some company!
BENNETT: Of course.
And... if you do ever remember anything, about what it was like, I truly would love to hear about it.
LAURA: I'm so sorry I ended up missing the picnic!
I tried asking Heather about it, and she wouldn't say much, but she did say it was the most fun she's had in a while.
I hope you had a good time, too?
With all that's going on, it's nice to take time now and then just to relax with people you care about.
Oh, don't worry!
I know I missed this picnic, but there will always be others!
This region is so beautiful, after all-- there are so many places to go and things to see.
And maybe next time, Bennett and my sisters will be able to make it, too!
LAURA: I hope you've been taking care of yourself?
Actually, I'm glad you stopped by.
I........ wasn't exactly thrilled, when I found out Bennett had sent you out to check on me,
But at the same time, I was very grateful.
I was so worried, and........
I couldn't handle it on my own.
But you found them both, safe and sound.
And as worried as I'd been, when I saw them both, I was even happier.
I really appreciate your help.
Things with my sisters........
Aren't going to be as easy to patch up as I'd hoped.
But while we were out there, I felt like we were taking steps forward.
They may have been baby steps,
But any step forward is better than none at all!
I have faith in all of us.
LAURA: It's good to see you again outside of battle, haha!
Truthfully, I was a bit........ concerned for you.
That girl who was with you-- Flora, I think her name was?
She was a bit........
Well, she reminded me a little of Charlotte,
When Charlotte was at her worst.
So angry, and dismissive.
But Charlotte--
I won't say she's perfect now, but she's certainly gotten better.
And I really hope Flora can, too!
I'm sure she can. She just needs a little time to grow, and some people to believe in her.
I’m glad you were able to be there for her, \PN, at least for a little while.
LAURA: I was talking to Serra a little while ago, and she told me about the adventure you had with Victini!
It sounds like a nice trip you all had.
I wonder why Bennett didn't tell me, though........
I never knew he could cook!
Haha, I wish I'd been able to see it!
Maybe I'll go check out Aegir Cave sometime, when the League's not too busy.
If you wanted to come along, that would be amazing!
Maybe we could get some more people to come along, too........
We could make a whole picnic! Or even a tea party!
Aah, a tea party with friends sounds lovely.
I'll talk to everyone and let you know, okay?
Before I do, though........
I wanted to thank you for being there for Bennett.
I know you've had some trouble in the past, and I'm really grateful you're giving him another chance.
I know it means a lot to him, too.
LAURA: Bennett and I were just talking about the League.
It's been........ fairly quiet, since all of this started up.
I guess since most people who would be strong enough to challenge the Elite Four are already helping out here, with all the Legendaries.
And I don't mind the quiet, really!
But I can't help worrying a little, about Bennett.
He's only just got the position, and........
Please don't tell him I told you, but I think he might still be beating himself up a little.
About what happened before, I mean.
Anyway, I think it might help him if he could do some more battling, just to remind himself that he deserves to be there.
So, for his sake, I hope the League gets some more challengers soon.
And for yours, of course, new Champion!
LAURA: I can hardly agree with this atmosphere, but........
I'm glad that everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
LAURA: You'll come by my garden again some time, won't you?
LAURA: Do you think that bar carries herbal teas?
I haven't wanted to bother about it........
LAURA: Make sure you're taking plenty of breaks and staying hydrated!
People aren't so different from flowers.
We all need time to grow.
ELIAS: Master \PN!
I heard you've decided to grace us with your presence once again...
I dare not pretend I understand your intentions, but know that I am humbled, repentant, and beholden nonetheless.
It is for this reason that I've returned to see of what service I may be.
If you have but a moment to listen to the apologies of a humiliated servant--
I wish to express my heartfelt regret for my prior blindness.
Not any blindness that affected my eyes, no-- but the blindness of my misplaced faith.
Truth be bared, I have been informed as to your true nature...
That is, that you are the avatar of Arceus--
Do not try to deny it, Master \PN. It is by your power that my eyes are open now.
I understand fully how it was you who willed Meteor unmade, and how you triumphed over the blasphemer Lin to save your own kin.
Of course, I am not without discretion.
I understand that any attempts to deny this truth are merely to preserve the sanctity of your secret, privacy, and the faith you ask from others.
This, I shall respect unflinchingly.
In the meantime, from now until the end of my days, please understand that if you need anything at all,
I am wholly at your disposal.
ELIAS: My Lord...
I see you have returned my Master's progeny to us after all...
That your mercy and power would run even this deep...
Truly...
I am moved to tears of joy...
...Though, I also received a curious report recently.
There was a blaze within the sanctum?
And the entrance has been sealed?
These events...
Surely would not be related...
Would they...
...My Lord?
I had many personal affects in there.
Memorabilia, personal writings, sermons and scripts, and tokens of history, both of the order and of my time with my dear former master...
If that has all been lost...
...Please forgive me, my Lord.
I have just remembered that I needed to inspect the quality of the stock back here.
...I believe I shall be inspecting and sampling it quite thoroughly for some time.
ELIAS: I say, there was quite a strapping young Trainer around here recently.
Sunglasses and a black coat and hat...
A wonderful choice of attire if I do say so myself.
ELIAS: To have been on a pilgrimage with you by my side,
And to have witnessed the future for myself,
With these two eyes that you gave me...
No amount of devotion is equal to my debt.
For as long as I yet draw breath, I shall not forget this blessing.
ELIAS: Greetings, Master \PN.
It has... been an ordeal, has it not?
I refer, of course, to our prior battle, and the guest who accompanied you.
I understand well that I am not well-versed in the ways of the young,
But it seems to me that that young woman was particularly spiteful.
Her strength in battle was admirable, but I fear that the strength of her character was not its equal.
But she is yet young-- perhaps there is still time for her to learn.
Here I am, going on. Forgive me, my Lord.
I am sure there is none of this that you do not know already.
As always, your patience is admirable.
With myself, as well as... others.
ELIAS: My Lord!
My apologies. \PN.
Please, have a seat, if you have the time.
I understand your time is valuable,
And there is much still to do.
But if ever you are in need of rest,
Or even want of it,
This may be a good place to do so.
If truth be bared, I have found it... a strangely good place to contemplate some things.
ELIAS: Ah, my child has taken one step into the light.
This, too, is your doing,
Isn't it, my Lord?
ELIAS: Care to partake in communion?
Though, I suppose that is a rather contentuous ritual for someone such as yourself.
ELIAS: What can I do for you, my Lord?
ELIAS: It is never too late to share a few spirits between friends.
ELIAS: Pax tecum, my lord.
ELIAS: Do tell me if I can get you anything else.
ELIAS: Mx. Flores, would you care to join us?
ADRIENN: Ah, why not?
I can spare a few minutes at the least.
ELIAS: What can I get you this evening?
ADRIENN: Something light, please.
I prefer to have my wits within arm's reach.
ELIAS: For our esteemed director,
Perhaps a rosé wine,
With a strawberry accent and pea flower flourish,
ELIAS: Shall I put it on the rocks?
ADRIENN: If you would, please.
ELIAS: It is yours to enjoy.
ADRIENN: Much appreciated~
When we first met, I wouldn't exactly have taken you for the bartending type.
How did you get into something like this?
ELIAS: It is, perhaps, an expected answer.
My former master bade me learn the basics, that I might better serve him in the realm of leisure too.
...That is what I had thought before, but I cannot help but believe now,
Perhaps he requested this not for his service, but that in partaking of my craft, I might lower my own inhibitions.
I might find the closeness I falsely believed I was barred from.
Vinum et amici laetificant cor.
It is too late for him to see it now, but I believe he may have been right.
As a humble servant left in this world, I suppose I simply have faith that it is so,
And that a moderate knowledge and practice of mixing might go the mile to brightening another's day.
ELIAS: It is especially so, should that be the time of my Lord.
ADRIENN: ...Ah,
You do know that \PN isn't actually an Arceus, right?
That was just a rumor Julia started.
\PN has even dealt with the actual Arceus by now...
ELIAS: I am aware of both of these things, in fact.
But I ask, what difference does it make?
For some, the Lord is in the sky.
Others, in the heart.
For an old man past his prime with little left but the time to find peace,
I find the Lord in the bonds and triumphs shared in close company.
We find God in our friends that we might have each other to cherish.
It is here in these moments that we know we are not alone, sola fide.
What more can faith ask for?
ADRIENN: An English translation, perhaps...
ELIAS: Ahah.
Quidquid Latine dictum sit altum videtur.
That is the way of things, after all.
ANNA: Hi, \PN!
Still on duty?
Don't worry, I'm right there with you!
Mr. Shadow and I are gonna have the region on lock!
...Like, in a friendly, non-authoritarian not-at- all world-ending type of way!
Obviously!
Like, um--
The other day we helped rescue this lost Lillipup!
Did you know that Mr. Shadow secretly really likes puppies?
Don't tell anyone!
Except the puppies!
Do tell them.
Tell all of them.
It's nice to see you around here still, but you've totally gotta come with us to play in the toybox next time!
You wouldn't believe what we found in one of the chests!
It's totally gonna be a surprise.
Eeeeee, no just kidding, I can't keep it a surprise--
It was an entire
Inflatable
Jumping castle!
Just like Dad's!
But, um, bouncier!
And smaller.
And not really like his at all.
BUT,
It's still awesome and we're gonna see what happens if we surrounded it with those pink jumpy bubble thingies!
It's gonna be-- what is it Charlotte says?
Lit!
It's gonna be lit.
ANNA: Hey, so, what exactly happened to Lin anymore?
I mean, I was asleep for so long, and now everything is so quiet...
I heard what happened, but not exactly what happened, you know?
If I'm being honest, there's a part of me that kind of misses her?
I mean, sure, she was responsible for nearly ending the world,
Uncountable property damage,
Ending who knows how many lives,
And personally giving Laura at least three more severe phobias...
And I'm not saying any of that is okay,
...But it feels wrong to not have to be at least a little bit on guard for her anymore.
Like when you're going down the stairs and there's one more step than you think there is and you have like a mini earthquake!
I gotta just count how many stairs there are again, right?
That's how these things go, I guess.
Remind myself and take it one step at a time.
Thanks for taking care of everything until I woke up!
I feel like I really dropped the ball,
But there was no gravity?
So it just kinda floated away and became one with the sun,
And now I don't have a ball anymore.
So that's kind of sad.
But now that I'm awake, I can just go buy a new ball!
I don't know how that fits into the metaphor,
But I'm sure that it does somehow!
What were we talking about again?
...Oh, I should get Lin a ball too!
Maybe three!
That way she can learn personal responsibility and also how to dribble!
Once again, don't think about the metaphor too hard, okay? It's shy.
Just like her!
She'll never show it, but I'm sure she really appreciates everything you've done in her own, twisted, rule-breaking way.
But don't tell her I told you that!
She'll probably replace my conditioner with silly string.
Actually, you can tell her; that sounds kinda funny!
ANNA: Keep smiling!
If you hold a smile for five minutes, you start to feel happy accidentally!
It's like, muscle conditioning or something?
Does the smile make the joy or does the joy make the smile?
ANNA: You gotta come by the castle one of these days!
Dad and Noel and I have been trying out a new three- way chess game...
It sucks, but it probably won't suck more if we deal you in and make it four ways!
ANNA: Hey, did you know?
Nostra's still watching over us even now.
She didn't tell me or anything this time.
I just know it's true.
ANNA: Okay, but it would be funny if, like, a Regirock spawned in this club,
And everyone thought its UNUNUNUNUN was just part of the beat?
I wonder how long it would take someone to notice...
ARC: And here he is!
The man of the hour!
ARC: And here she is!
The lady of the hour!
ARC: And here they are!
The savior of the hour!
ARC: \PN!!!!
Always knew you'd do it.
There's no words enough to express our thanks, so instead the memories we make from here on out will have to do.
With the Champion back in our back pocket, there's no fight we can't both pick and win.
ARC: But there's a lot to explain.
Why don't you come on over here?
ARC: I'd ask where in the world you've been, but for better or worse, I've got a few guesses on the matter.
Lemme cut straight to the chase--
Meteor's out, but the chaos is still in.
The good news is that any grunts that weren't turned in turned over a new leaf, and the admins...
Well, ain't none of them left.
Not even Lin, thanks to you.
Anyone who still had ties in the higher ranks is on our side now.
It's a total team KO if ever I've seen one.
The bad news is that the damage is done.
Their goal of opening the New World ultimately succeeded.
Thanks to you, it didn't get so far as overwriting this one, but...
To put it simply, they're starting to overlap.
The unformed New World has been leaking into ours for quite some time now, causing this, that, and the other problem.
For one thing, the energy from the New World has awoken new heights of potential in Pokémon everywhere.
Where it was impossible to go above Level 100 before, Pokémon have been sighted growing to as high as Level 150 now.
Double the worlds, double the power-- or somethin'.
An' there's one other... complication.
You know how there's supposed to be some Pokémon out there that there's only one of in the world?
Yeah, so... about that.
Not... anymore.
It seems like anything can appear or exist in the New World.
Uh, so...
What I'm trying to say here is that yesterday fourteen Genesect fell out of the New World and were running amok on Main Street.
We already took care of them, so no need to worry about that, but-- you get the point.
All sorts of Pokémon have appeared in all sorts of places, but Legendaries in particular, given their big power, tend to create problems when they show up.
For instance, the TV station was totally trashed after a Zapdos spawned inside it...
Those few seconds of the recording before it cut out were pretty incredible though, can't lie.
Lots of the other leaders are already away hunting them and putting out Legendary-related fires.
If you're up to it, we can definitely use your help.
My bad for springin' this on you right when you get back.
After shit hit the fan, I decided I'd convert this place into a base of operations for dealing with these kinds of issues all over the city.
By the old policy, only League Leaders and Champions would've been allowed in, but that was Ame's idea, and...
Well, this works out better now anyway.
There's a lot of cool stuff in this place that might be worth checking out too, so by all means, take your time!
We've got an arena behind us that you can use to spar with the friendlies...
The Battle Pavilion's on your left-- free use for all trainers now.
No end to the fights there, and you might see some familiar faces.
And finally, I rigged one of the dance floors into a pseudo-map of the region over on the right.
We're using that to mark down where reports of New World Anomalies come in-- be it Legendaries or overlap points...
So talk to the folks over there if you wanna help 'em out!
Whatever you do, champ, it's good to have you back!
Hit me up if you need anything!
ARC: Hey, Champ!
What's this I hear about you capturing Meloetta?
Maaan, I wish I'd been there.
ARC: ...
Hey, I know now's not the best time,
But do you think sometime she'd want to do a show here?
It'd liven up the place, and honestly...
Collaborating with an artist like that would be a dream.
But after things have settled down, for sure.
Maybe float the idea past her?
In the meantime, keep up the good work as always, \PN.
ARC: Glad everything went well with the poachers.
I've got to admit, I wasn't so sure about this at first--
Working with Pokémon poachers and all--
But I'm glad it worked out well.
I was surprised, actually.
They seem like a pretty good lot, all things considered.
A few of 'em have even been stopping by to battle it out at the Pavilion.
Just more proof that people can change for the better, I guess.
ARC: Man, when I offered to help out with the band, I wasn't expecting that to happen.
...Even without the New World stuff, it's been a bit more than I expected, honestly.
They're all working really hard, but between you and me, not one of those kids knows anything about mixing.
It's been a lot.
I don't mind helping out, but... between running this place, organizing the Anomaly hunts, and the band, I feel like I'm in a bit over my head.
Maybe I'll see about trying to teach Hardy the basics.
He seems like a quick learner when it comes to music, and maybe if he picks up a few things I can stay more in the background.
Still be there to help out and all, but not have quite so much to do.
Ah... Sorry, \PN, I guess I was thinking out loud.
I'll talk to Hardy about it, don't worry.
You just focus on relaxing for a bit.
Arce-- Uh.
Everyone knows you deserve it.
ARC: How've you been managing it all, Champ?
Seems like you've been helpin' out with a lot of those Anomalies.
I can't say how grateful I am.
They just keep coming.
I guess it keeps things from getting boring around here, at least!
ARC: I won't lie, \PN, this is nice.
No Anomalies, no one fearing for their lives...
Just some good music.
Good friends, too.
...Well, maybe 'friends' is a stretch for some; I know people've had their issues,
And probably still do.
But as long as nobody wrecks my club fighting, I'm okay with that.
Means I can start getting back to the music.
Thanks again, Champ. For everything.
ARC: Digging the beat?
ARC: Stay strong out there!
ARC: This is the place we come together.
To be ourselves, and to be better than just ourselves.
That's why this is my home.
ARC: Music makes us more than who we are.
We're not people, we're vibes.
CAIN: Hey.
Thanks for helping me out of there, ahaha.
I may be pretty good at gettin' around, but that--
That was a heck of a place to wake up.
I guess... I've got a lot of things to think about,
But when I got in here and saw everyone?
It felt good.
So maybe that's a good place to start, right?
Anyway, this place is awesome!
I never thought something like this could pop up right in Reborn City!
I'm gonna hang around for a bit, catch up with everyone.
Apparently there's a whole bunch of those Anomaly things running around?
That sounds like it'd be fun to check out.
...As long as, y'know, I don't get stuck in there again.
But if I do, I'll count on you to rescue me!
Your fair prince!
Haha...
But seriously, thanks again.
CAIN: Looks like I gotta add dealing with our messed up family to the loooooong list of things I owe you for, huh?
Thanks for looking out for Aya.
I wish I coulda done that better myself, but...
Uh, well, in my defense, I am still the younger sibling.
I don't act like it, I know~
But my youthful complexion and dulcet tones do not lie to you~
I am still young~
Still fertile~
I mean-- what, who said that?
But you know, it's nice to actually have a crew to sing with too.
You'll still come to all of our shows even if they keep getting invaded, right?
You can invade our shows any time, \PN~
CAIN: \PN, you've been holding out on me!
I've been catching up with everyone a bit,
And Julia told me everything.
So did everyone else.
All that time in that cave, and you never mentioned you got kidnapped by a Darkrai?
Or that you went off on some romantic getaway?
Or that all this time you've been a Zoroark in disguise??
Aya wasn't too sure about the last one, but...
Seriously, what the hell?
I know I just got back and everything, but you can tell me things!
...And I'm sorry about hitting on you, if you're really a Pokémon.
That's weird.
I won't make you fill me in...
...On everything right now.
But later, 'kay?
CAIN: Wanna dance with me?
CAIN: You know, if you ever wanna get out of here, I'm sure I can find us a quiet place...
CAIN: Gotta be honest, dancing in platforms is one of the hardest things I've done in them.
Second hardest only though!
CAIN: You gotta feel the music in your heart!
FERN: Oh hey, look who it is.
Hey, now that we have a sec, I wanted to ask you.
What happened with that tournament?
Don't bother denying it.
Julia already told me about you going off to that big tournament in Galar.
Gotta say, I'm a little disappointed you lost.
After you beat me, you just go and lose to some stranger?
Well, it doesn't matter.
You may be the Champion or whatever now, and you may've beaten me back there too, but I keep getting stronger.
So you better not get complacent.
Because if you don't keep training, I'm going to leave you in my dust!
FERN: You managed to catch any Legendaries yet?
I still can't believe what that cat put us through.
I know I said I wanted to catch it so you couldn't, but...
If I never see that thing again, I'll be happy.
FERN: Yo.
You did it, huh?
Like, again.
For real this time.
One of the two; who's to say?
Congrats, \PN.
Thanks for picking up the garbage.
No sass.
You did good.
FERN: Stay fresh, "Champ".
No telling how long that title's gonna belong to you.
FERN: Stay fresh, Champ.
FERN: Haven't you done enough yet?
FERN: Careful.
If you spend too much time waiting around here, you might actually slip.
Then I'll overtake you for real.
